module: Unit tests for gameplay/vehiclePresencePolicy. Each testXxx function receives a test context `ctx` (with assert and assertEqual) provided by the game's test runner; this is not a gameplay extension to load.
notes: The tests cover mode validation/normalization, the default unseated mode depending on context, and action map permissions.

testModeValidationAndNormalization.desc: Checks isValidMode (driver, passenger, unrestricted valid; observer invalid) and normalizeMode (fallback, default value "passenger").

ctx.desc: Test context with assert and assertEqual.

testDefaultUnseatedMode.desc: Checks defaultUnseatedMode: unrestricted only in freeroam without multiseat, passenger in all other cases (multiplayer, career, nil).

testActionMapPermissions.desc: Checks allowsActionMap: driver only on "driving", passenger never, unrestricted always.
